name: What are the common signs of water damage on a roof?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of water damage on a roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of water damage on a roof include water stains on ceilings or walls, peeling paint, bubbling plaster, or a musty odor indoors. Externally, look for missing shingles, cracked flashing, sagging roof sections, or blocked gutters. Identifying these early can help prevent more extensive and costly repairs. We recommend a professional assessment if you notice any of these indicators, especially after heavy rains common in the DFW area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of water damage include interior stains, peeling paint, and exterior issues like missing shingles or sagging sections. Early detection helps prevent costly repairs.
